disposition_reason: Original ICP-MS measurements of lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury in 150 broiler breast, liver, neck and kidney samples from slaughter shops in five Tamil Nadu cities.

study.design: Market survey of broiler edible parts from live-chicken slaughter shops in five cities
study.market: live chicken slaughter shops in Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy and Salem, Tamil Nadu, India
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7700, He mode) after microwave digestion (HNO3 + H2O2) of 0.5 g homogenized wet tissue
study.lod_text: LOD Pb 0.18, Cd 0.95, As 0.21, Hg 0.25 ppb; LOQ Pb 1.85, Cd 1.95, As 2.10, Hg 2.5 ppb (Section 2.5)
study.qa: Reference materials (not named): recoveries Pb 89.60, Cd 92.51, As 94.52, Hg 90.21%; RSD Pb<7.0, Cd<1.49, As<2.44, Hg<1.39
